name: WordPress
support: Open-source software supported by a global developer community and independent hosting companies.
technology: PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
capabilities: Customizable pages, blogs, and online stores
REST API for connecting other applications
limitations: Frequent updates and maintenance are necessary
Too many plugins can reduce performance

name: Drupal
support: Open-source CMS supported by its developer community and the Drupal Association.
technology: PHP, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL or SQLite, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

name: Joomla
support: Open-source CMS maintained by volunteers and supported by Open Source Matters.
technology: PHP, MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

name: Shopify
support: Commercial subscription-based platform developed and hosted by Shopify Inc.
technology: Shopify-managed cloud platform and database, Liquid templates, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
limitations: Monthly subscription and possible additional fees
Advanced features may require paid apps

name: Wix
support: Commercial website-building and hosting platform operated by Wix.com Ltd.
technology: Wix-managed cloud hosting and database collections, JavaScript, Node.js through Velo, HTML, and CSS.
capabilities: Built-in CMS, booking, and ecommerce features
limitations: Moving an entire site to another platform is difficult
Some advanced features require paid plans
